memories.text: Bruno Keller owns the Ferry queue.
Amara Osei is the Cedar lead.
Dmitri Volkov owns the Gantry scheduler.
Chiara Rossi is the Marlin lead.
Farid Haddad owns the Relay gateway.
Hiro Tanaka owns the Hopper ingest service.
Ines Duarte is the Tamarind lead.
Kavya Menon is the Vesper lead.
Nikhil Rao owns the Conduit stream.
Mila Novak is the Pinnacle lead.
Pablo Reyes owns the Lattice store.
Olga Petrova is the Quartz lead.
Rania Said owns the Prism dashboard.
Quinn Abbott is the Sable lead.
Tara Brennan owns the Anvil builder.
Umar Bello is the Umbra lead.
Yusuf Demir owns the Mosaic search index.
Wen Zhao is the Willow lead.
Failed Cedar jobs are retried 8 times before they are parked.
Failed Marlin jobs are retried 9 times before they are parked.
Failed Juniper jobs are retried 10 times before they are parked.
Failed Osprey jobs are retried 11 times before they are parked.
Failed Tamarind jobs are retried 12 times before they are parked.
Failed Vesper jobs are retried 8 times before they are parked.
The Osprey rollback window is 60 minutes after a failed deploy.
The Tamarind rollback window is 65 minutes after a failed deploy.
The Vesper rollback window is 70 minutes after a failed deploy.
The Pinnacle rollback window is 45 minutes after a failed deploy.
The Quartz rollback window is 50 minutes after a failed deploy.
As of March, the Cedar default model was Merlin-7B.
As of October, the Cedar default model is Kestrel-3B; the Merlin-7B model has been retired.
As of March, the Marlin default model was Heron-4B.
As of October, the Marlin default model is Kestrel-9B; the Heron-4B model has been retired.
As of March, the Juniper default model was Heron-12B.
As of October, the Juniper default model is Merlin-2B; the Heron-12B model has been retired.
As of March, the Osprey default model was Swift-6B.
As of October, the Osprey default model is Merlin-7B; the Swift-6B model has been retired.
Nimbus Metrics support hours are 7 to 6 on weekdays.
Falconer Logs support hours are 9 to 6 on weekdays.
Brightwell Mail support hours are 8 to 6 on weekdays.

documents.title: Cedar architecture
documents.content:
# Overview
Cedar is an internal platform. It runs scheduled jobs and serves interactive requests.

# Jobs
Jobs flow through the Ferry queue. A failed job is retried up to 3 times before it is parked.

# Model serving
Cedar serves Kestrel-3B on the GPU host. Interactive requests use the fast path and scheduled jobs use the deep path.

documents.title: Cedar runbook
documents.content:
# Deploy
Deploy Cedar with the release script and watch the dashboard for 5 minutes.

# Rollback
Roll back within 15 minutes of a failed deploy by running the rollback script.
